description: We are B.I.G. Tech (Boundless Intelligence & Global Tech), an AI and software engineering team founded by Computer Science students from UESB (State University of Southwest Bahia) in Vitória da Conquista, Brazil. We operate with a tech-company mindset, combining scalable software architecture and advanced AI to turn complex data into actionable global solutions.
summary:
Climate volatility, water scarcity, and soil degradation are invalidating traditional farming calendars worldwide. Yet, existing precision agriculture tools require high digital literacy, complex dashboards, and stable broadband — excluding the smallholder and family farmers who need them most.

S.O.L. (Satellite-Oriented LLM) solves this by turning NASA’s Earth observation fleet into a 100% Voice-First field partner. By simply speaking in natural language and local rural units, farmers share their plot size, crop, and main challenge (drought, pests, soil exhaustion, or market prices). S.O.L. fuses data from seven NASA missions (POWER, SMAP, GPM, MODIS, ECOSTRESS, Landsat, and SRTM) with scientific agronomy (FAO/Embrapa), computer vision, and IoT telemetry to deliver clear spoken guidance. It compares three actionable scenario — Current Practice, Regenerative Crop Rotation, and Green Manure/Low-Water Management — 
showing real impacts on water, soil health, cost, and yield, displaying visual charts only when requested by voice.

Designed for offline resilience and omnichannel scale (Web, 2G phone calls, SMS, community radio, and enterprise APIs), S.O.L. democratizes climate adaptation from family farms to large cooperatives.
details:
THE PAIN WE SOLVE
Farmers today fight on two fronts: extreme climate unpredictability (irregular rain, heatwaves, exhausted soils) and digital exclusion. Millions of producers cannot use traditional ag-tech platforms because those tools demand reading fluency, complex registration, and high-speed internet. When a farmer makes a blind decision on planting windows or crop choice, they risk losing their entire livelihood.

WHAT S.O.L. DOES & HOW IT WORKS
S.O.L. (Satellite-Oriented LLM) is an intelligent, 100% Voice-First agricultural advisor that puts orbital intelligence directly into the farmer’s hands through natural conversation.
1. Zero-Friction Voice Dialogue: With a single tap, the farmer talks to S.O.L. as they would to a trusted neighbor — using regional land units (hectares, "alqueires", or square meters) and everyday terms.
2. Multimodal Satellite & Field Fusion: Using geolocation, S.O.L. combines seven NASA Earth Observation datasets (POWER, SMAP, GPM, MODIS, ECOSTRESS, Landsat, and SRTM) with verified agronomic literature (FAO/UN, Embrapa, SciELO), field computer vision (diagnosing crop pests, nutrient deficiencies, and straw cover from a quick photo or video), and local IoT soil/weather sensors.
3. Three Actionable Scenarios: Instead of overwhelming the user with raw data, S.O.L. delivers a clear spoken diagnosis and simulates three practical paths: Current Management, Regenerative Crop Rotation, and Green Manure / Water-Saving Management. For each option, the farmer hears the expected harvest yield alongside Water savings, Soil recovery, and Cost/Simplicity.
4. On-Demand Visuals: Built for bright sunlight and working hands in the field, the screen stays clean and only displays comparative charts when requested by voice.

BENEFITS & INTENDED IMPACT (FROM SMALLHOLDERS TO AGRIBUSINESS)
- Cognitive Adaptation (Personas N1 to N4): S.O.L. automatically adapts its language. It speaks in warm, jargon-free analogies for smallholder farmers without formal schooling (N1/N2), and dynamically shifts to high-precision technical metrics (NDVI, SMAP root-zone moisture, evapotranspiration, ZARC windows) for extension technicians (N3), cooperatives, and corporate agronomists (N4).
- Omnichannel & Offline-First Reach: To ensure no farmer is left behind due to lack of connectivity, S.O.L. scales across an offline-capable Web App (PWA), toll-free 2G voice calls (IVR/URA), USSD menus, SMS alerts, automated daily bulletins for rural community radios, and REST/GraphQL APIs for cooperatives, ERPs, and agricultural insurance.
- Sustainable Social & Environmental Impact: S.O.L. operates on a B2B2C impact model — 100% free for family farmers, sustained by SaaS/API licensing for large agribusinesses, cooperatives, and public extension programs. It directly advances UN SDGs 2 (Zero Hunger), 6 (Clean Water), 13 (Climate Action), and 15 (Life on Land).

HOW OUR PROJECT IS CREATIVE & FACTORS CONSIDERED
- Grounded AI ("Zero Numeric Hallucination"): In farming, a hallucinated number can ruin a harvest. S.O.L. separates reasoning from calculation: every spoken number is strictly grounded in deterministic predictive models and verified before reaching the farmer's ears.
- Biological & Human Safety: S.O.L. prioritizes regenerative soil practices, blocks chemical pesticide dosage prescriptions, and always reinforces collaboration with local agricultural technicians and rural extension services.
- Data Sovereignty & Privacy (LGPD): Sensitive farm coordinates and production histories remain encrypted locally on the farmer’s device (AES-256), while regional crop models improve across harvests using Federated Learning and differential privacy.

TOOLS, SOFTWARE & HARDWARE ECOSYSTEM
- Earth Observation & Science: NASA POWER, SMAP, GPM, MODIS, ECOSTRESS, Landsat, SRTM (geospatial harmonization via STAC, COG, and Zarr), combined with RAG over FAO/UN and Embrapa knowledge bases.
- AI, Voice & Vision: Multi-model LLM routing (Google Gemini, OpenAI, local Ollama with offline fallback), ElevenLabs & Web Speech API for natural voice interaction, and edge-ready Computer Vision.
- Platform & Field Hardware: HTML5/CSS3/JS Progressive Web App, Python (FastAPI), Node.js, Web Crypto API, and field integration architecture for LoRaWAN/MQTT IoT sensors and 2G telecom gateways (IVR/USSD/SMS).
